Look for the badge on our homepage: it reads Client Confidence Rating 2025 and nothing else, and the name of the organization behind it isn't shown anywhere on the site. The rating was given in March 2026 for the 2025 calendar year. No fee was paid to be considered for the rating and nothing is paid to display it. We reviewed the survey questionnaire before using the rating and have a reasonable basis to believe it is structured to make favorable and unfavorable responses equally easy and is not designed to produce a predetermined result.
